methods.description: Pinned original observers and existing snapshot helper establish the actual before-change implementation and cache contract. Exact code/tests/docs remain in Git. Fake-clock tests exercise the production observer and gh adapter, including actual complete-304/exit-1 semantics, controlled latency/read costs, quota and terminal reconciliation. Historical timing is qualified in issue1791 and documentation; no live workflow or scientific rerun establishes a claimed saving. Normal post-integration adoption remains open.
methods.software: Node 24; repository test runner; GitHub CLI existing authenticated read adapter
methods.units: monotonic milliseconds; HTTP requests/status counts; separate UTC wall-clock fields
